facts.function: parts of solenoid valves controlling brake fluid

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8481 covers valves and parts thereof; Section XVII note 2(e) excludes articles of heading 8481 from vehicle parts (8708)
Section XVI parts note: parts of valves follow 8481
GRI 6: 8481.90 parts; 8481.90.90 other; .40 other (not valve bodies)

rejected_alternatives.reason: Section XVII note 2(e) excludes articles of heading 8481

missing_facts: material of the parts (copper, iron or steel, other)
classification.rationale: H328055 treated solenoid valves in a brake control box as valves of 8481.20; parts of such valves go to 8481.90, and Section XVII note 2(e) bars 8708. The 10-digit line depends on material and part type, assumed other.
